from sunday 25th october, sunday morning mass will be at 10 am winter time. drumkilly & kilnaleck church mass from the 1st november - 6.30 pm winter time (alternate weeks). adoration of the blessed sacrament: on sunday november 1st all saints day, we will have adoration of the blessed sacrament after 10 am mass until 5 pm(st. mary’s). 10am to 5pm (st. joseph’s). this will facilitate all visiting the graves of their bereaved, so having prayed for them in the graveyard they can pray for them in the church and of equal significance they can expose their broken hearts to the healing power of jesus in the blessed sacrament friday evening masses during the month of november where we remember all our loved ones who have died - drumkilly church at 7 pm friday 6th november (first friday) crosserlough church at 8 pm friday 13th november kilnaleck church at 8 pm friday 20th november drumkilly church at 8 pm friday 27th november during these masses parishioners are asked to bring along a candle which will be lit at the altar and placed on the cross in the sanctuary a tree of remembrance will be placed in each church during november – place the name of your deceased loved one on the tree so that they will be prayed for and remembered during mass. kilmore diocesan ptaa mass and presentation of pins on sunday 1st november in st mary's church carrigallan at 2pm. followed by dinner and dance in kilbracken arms. anyone eligible for pins contact rosaleen before saturday 24th october. to order pins or book tickets for dinner contact rosaleen smith

. music seamus farrell. tickets €35 first aid classes : in crosserlough old school wednesday nights at 7.30 pm. new members over 18 welcome. please come along and learn some basic life saving skills that could save a life. altar servers : meeting for parents of current & new in-coming altar servers in the parish will be held on thursday 5th nov in drumkilly hall at 8pm advent preparation workshop: fr. turlough baxter will host a workshop on preparing for advent in our parishes at the kilmore pastoral centre on 7 november, from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. the workshop will explore practical ways to make advent a meaningful time of preparation for christmas. everyone with an interest in parish life and liturgy is warmly welcome. crosserlough (kilnaleck)
